Stated Claim / Post Context:
Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico?

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico? ===

[Source 1 — www.aljazeera.com (Bias: Center / State-Funded International)] (URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/who-is-el-chapo-isidro-the-alleged-cartel-boss-arrested-in-mexico?traffic_source=rss):
Who is El Chapo Isidro, the alleged cartel boss arrested in Mexico?

Mexican forces arrested Chapo Isidro in Sinaloa. He was on the FBI’s most wanted list and faces US drug charges.

[Source 2 — www.perthnow.com.au (Bias: Independent / Unrated)] (URL: https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/crime/mexico-nabs-top-cartel-boss-one-of-fbi-10-most-wanted-c-23195746):
Mexico captures top drug lord 'El Chapo Isidro'

Mexico's top cartel boss "El Chapo Isidro" - one of the FBI's most wanted - has been captured, triggering violence that's left at least 11 people dead.

[Source 3 — www.npr.org (Bias: Lean Left / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.npr.org/2026/11/21/nx-s1-6049672/cartel-boss-el-chapo-isidro-detained):
Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off violence

Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, better known as "El Chapo Isidro," was one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives. His arrest in northwest Mexico on Saturday has sparked violence in the region.
